title: In-Memory KV Store with Nested Transactions
summary: SET/GET/DELETE/COUNT with BEGIN/ROLLBACK/COMMIT that nest. A machine-coding classic that tests data-structure design and undo logs.
hints: Keep a `Map<String,String> data` and a `Map<String,Integer> valueCounts`, so `count(value)` is O(1).
Each BEGIN pushes an **undo log**: before the first change to a key in that transaction, record the key's previous value (or 'absent').
ROLLBACK replays the top log's previous values and pops it. COMMIT throws away **all** logs, because the changes already live in `data`.
Every mutation goes through one private `put(key, valueOrNull)` that updates `data` and `valueCounts` together. Undo reuses it.
